review.rationale: Option A correctly preserves the v0.1 failure record, forbids same-Decision retry, introduces a new v0.2 Decision candidate with identical execution target, five-path scope, caps and non-authorizations, and mandates a single exact qwen3.7-max review whose sanitized response is captured in a persistent in-memory binding. Readback from that binding avoids any additional Provider request. Authorization is gated on APPROVE, confidence >=0.9, all booleans true, and zero blockers/corrections. Non-authorizations explicitly exclude Decision authorization, model request, validator execution, commits, and all downstream effects, preserving authority boundaries.
